_help: The books shown in the home page slider, in this order. To swap a book, change its id (the number in data/books.json, also the number at the start of the book's web address, e.g. /books/126-... is id 126). Then run:  node scripts/fetch_featured.mjs  to fetch its Google Books description, and rebuild. Each book needs an author, a cover and a description. The 'why' notes are just for people reading this file.

books.why: History - Thomas Arnold's classic on how Islam spread through peaceful preaching
Biography - first detailed life of Abdullah Yusuf Ali, translator of the Quran
Theology - Mutahhari on the Prophet's unschooled status
History - a full account of the Prophet's life, written for young readers and students
Biography - Imam Ali's justice, written by a Lebanese Christian author
